title: Archive extraction via tarfile.extractall (python) — review required
description: The python call tarfile.extractall extracts archive entries to disk. A hostile archive can carry traversal entry names (../../) that write outside the target directory. This lexical rule flags the extraction; the reviewer confirms entry names are validated or confined.
remediation: Validate every entry name with per-entry name validation before writing, rejecting absolute paths and parent traversal.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any tarfile.extractall call matches, including extraction of trusted archives. Archive trust needs human review.
